name: Grandalen - Bottenstugan
routeType: linear point-to-point official stage through Svartedalen from Grandalen to Bottenstugan; no ferry, rowboat or official alternate geometry found, but several parking/access points and local side-loop facilities exist nearby

officialSources.title: West Sweden Trails / Bohusleden: 8. Grandalen - Bottenstugan
keyFacts: Canonical current name is Grandalen - Bottenstugan.
Official WST slug is 8-grandalen-bottenstugan.
Official distance is 8.5 km.
Official estimated time is 3-4 h.
Official difficulty is red / hard.
Official surface is forest path.
Stage passes old cultural landscape inside Svartedalen, conifer forest, lake-rich bedrock, moss-covered boulders, tarns, croft ruins, viewpoints, swimming and fishing opportunities.
WST describes steep sections and says hiking experience and fitness are needed.
WST says bus access to Grandalen and Bottenstugan/Anvik is difficult or infrequent, and suggests Diserod Center as a practical alternative.

Compared WST GPX/API, Naturkartan API and OSM relation 125129; recommended WST GPX/API after de-duplication and documented the 49.4 m official Stage 8 to Stage 9 gap.
Collected Grandalen, Abborrvattnet, Tvangen, Ovre Langevatten, Holmevatten, Alevatten, Bottenstugan and off-route/pending/suppress facility records.
Captured Grandalen bus/parking, Bottenstugan parking, Anvik local-service access, Diserods centrum transfer hub, mid-stage parking and Nartrafik/rural-service caveats.
Checked WST comments, route apps, blogs and reports for forestry, stormfall, wet/rooty/steep terrain, wayfinding, Bottenstugan water conflict and shelter caveats.
Checked WST GPX against official protected-area layers and captured Svartedalen reserve/Natura 2000, Lysegarden water protection, fire, camping, dog, hunting, forestry, storm and water notes.

researchIterations.synthesisDecision: Stage 8 is strong enough for research-ready normalization with caveats. No targeted follow-up agent batch is needed before continuing to Stage 9; remaining caveats are normal pre-import live-status, GIS/sub-area and facility-clustering QA.

openQuestions: Before final import, recheck the WST forestry/gravel-road status between Ovre and Nedre Langevatten and the Svartedalen storm-damage notice.
During Stage 9 synthesis, decide how to handle the 49.4 m official WST/Naturkartan continuity gap at Bottenstugan.
Field-check Bottenstugan water signage and seasonality before marking it as reliable drinking water.
Cluster Bottenstugan north/south shelters, fireplace, dry toilet, tent place, water tap, information board and possible grillkata/access shelter to avoid duplicate records.
Verify whether Anvik has any practical fixed-route service at publication time; otherwise keep it as demand-responsive/check-ahead access only.
Confirm exact Svartedalen sub-area signs at Grandalen/Bottenstugan and Lysegarden water-protection subzone before encoding public rule warnings.
Keep Nedre Langevatten wind shelter, Bottenstugan waste basket and possible grillkata/access shelter pending until coordinate/existence verification.

importReadiness.geometry: ready; use official WST/Hoodin GPX/API after de-duplicating consecutive repeated coordinates; Naturkartan corroborates as simplified subset; OSM relation 125129 is validation-only due endpoint offsets and stale 7 km tag
importReadiness.endpoints: ready for Stage 8; official WST/Naturkartan endpoints are high-confidence, but the Stage 8 end to Stage 9 start has a 49.4 m official gap to resolve/document during Stage 9 normalization
importReadiness.commuteAccess: ready with strong rural-service caveats; Grandalen bus/parking and Bottenstugan parking are high-confidence, while Anvik is check-ahead/local-service access and Diserods centrum is an off-route hub
importReadiness.facilities: ready for selective normalization; Grandalen board, Abborrvattnet, Tvangen, Ovre Langevatten, Holmevatten, Alevatten and Bottenstugan clusters are captured with import/pending/suppress decisions
importReadiness.rulesAndSafety: ready as research notes; Svartedalen reserve/Natura 2000, Lysegarden water protection, fire, dog, camping, hunting and currentness notes are captured but sub-area/polygon/signage checks remain pre-import requirements
importReadiness.currentness: active WST forestry/gravel-road caution and Svartedalen storm-damage caution found on 2026-04-29; no explicit full closure or formal reroute found
normalizationNotes: Preserve WST official distance 8.5 km and computed official geometry length 8.127 km separately.
Use official WST endpoint [57.962139, 12.007714] for Grandalen start and [58.005099, 11.991055] for Bottenstugan end.
De-duplicate WST/Hoodin GPX repeated coordinates before geometry processing.
Do not use OSM relation 125129 as primary geometry; its 7 km distance tag appears stale and endpoints differ from official endpoints.
Do not auto-stitch Stage 8 to Stage 9 without addressing the 49.4 m official continuity gap.
Surface forestry work between Ovre and Nedre Langevatten as active trail-status/currentness metadata until WST removes it.
Surface Svartedalen storm-damage caution until the reserve manager removes or updates it.
Import Bottenstugan water only with seasonal/check-ahead caveat; carry-water warning remains appropriate.
Suppress Bottenstugan building as lodging until manager source says renovation is complete and booking/use is reopened.
Cluster Bottenstugan endpoint amenities to avoid duplicate shelter/fireplace/toilet/tent/water records.
Keep Anvik as check-ahead/demand-responsive access unless fixed scheduled service is verified.
Treat Vasttrafik timetables, fire bans, water availability, forestry notices and storm-damage notices as volatile.
